auth.note: Every endpoint below accepts a bearer token. The `/api/theses`, `/api/rules` and `/api/cards` writes are bearer-ONLY (apps/platform-app/src/routes/api-strategy.ts calls resolveBearerIdentity); everything else goes through resolveIdentity, which accepts a bearer token OR the browser's own alphaloop_session cookie. The owner of every write is always the token's resolved member.id; a body `ownerId` field is ignored, never honored.
auth.browserLogin: Browsers do not use this token. They sign in at GET /login with an email code delivered over Feishu (apps/platform-app/src/routes/login.ts) and get a signed alphaloop_session cookie. Cloudflare Access was never activated and is not part of the login path.

errors.400: { ok: false, error, field } - missing/invalid symbol, direction, visibility, targetLow/targetHigh/invalidationPrice, bullPoints/bearPoints
errors.401: { ok: false, error } - missing/invalid bearer token

tools.name: thesis.judgment.append

errors.400: { ok: false, error, field } - missing note
errors.403: thesis exists but is owned by another member

tools.notes: Append-only - there is no update/delete endpoint for a judgment. A correction is always a NEW judgment row.

tools.name: thesis.promote

errors.403: thesis exists but is owned by another member

tools.notes: system -> public. Idempotent if already public. Reversible since 2026-07-30: thesis.demote takes it back to system (2026-07-12 requirements §2.1 - 「一键升档（①→②→③）；降档时已生成的历史内容不回收（如实告知）」).

tools.name: thesis.demote

errors.403: thesis exists but is owned by another member

tools.notes: public -> system, owner-only. Idempotent if already system. `notice` is the verbatim 「降档已生效；此前已生成的报告/名片内容不回收。」 - demotion removes the row from other members' 名片 from now on and retracts NOTHING already generated while it was public (reports, cards, Feishu messages keep what they printed). Writes an audit_log row (category strategy_memory).

errors.400: { ok: false, error, field } - missing ruleText, invalid enforcement

tools.name: rule.disable

errors.403: rule exists but is owned by another member

tools.notes: Never deletes - sets enabled=0 + disabled_at. Idempotent on an already-disabled rule.

errors.400: { ok: false, error, field } - missing name, invalid visibility

tools.name: card.promote

errors.403: card exists but is owned by another member

tools.notes: system -> public, owner-only. Idempotent if already public. Until 2026-07-30 a card could only be published at create time.

tools.name: card.demote

errors.403: card exists but is owned by another member

tools.notes: public -> system, owner-only. Idempotent if already system. `notice` is the verbatim 「降档已生效；此前已生成的报告/名片内容不回收。」 - demotion removes the row from other members' 名片 from now on and retracts NOTHING already generated while it was public (reports, cards, Feishu messages keep what they printed). Writes an audit_log row (category strategy_memory).

tools.name: research.submit

body.question: string, required - the research question, in Chinese

errors.400: { ok: false, error, field } - missing question
errors.429: { ok: false, error, used, limit } - the member's per-trading-day research quota is spent; it resets at the US Eastern trading-day boundary

tools.notes: `redirect` is the task's own reading page (/research/<id>), where the step stream and the finished verdict appear. The verdict is also pushed to the member's Feishu DM when it completes.

tools.name: research.promote

errors.403: the research task belongs to another member
errors.404: no research task with that id

tools.notes: One-way, owner-only: a private verdict becomes visible to the circle. Idempotent on an already-public task (and a repeat writes no second audit entry). No downgrade endpoint exists.

tools.name: research.thesis

errors.400: { ok: false, error, field } - missing symbol, invalid direction, or the task has no conclusion to save
errors.403: the research task belongs to another member
errors.404: no research task with that id

tools.notes: 存为论点: turns a finished verdict into one of the caller's own theses, carrying that verdict's conclusion as the evidence point. The new thesis lands at `system` visibility - saving is not publishing.

tools.name: review.confirm

errors.403: the review belongs to another member

tools.notes: draft -> confirmed, one-way and idempotent. Confirming mirrors the conclusion into the member's private memory and sends their own Feishu confirmation card.

read_only_pages.name: strategy.page
read_only_pages.note: My discipline rules + my theses/strategy cards (every visibility) + the circle's public-only section.

read_only_pages.name: member.card
read_only_pages.note: A member's public card: public strategy cards + public theses only.

read_only_pages.name: stock.page
read_only_pages.note: Public stock analysis for that symbol, plus a 我的论点卡 section holding the CALLER's own theses and other members' PUBLIC ones - another member's private thesis never appears.

read_only_pages.name: proposal.detail
read_only_pages.note: Owner-only, 403 for a non-owner's real id, 404 for an unknown id.

read_only_pages.name: research.detail
read_only_pages.note: One research task: live step stream while it runs, then the verdict. Owner-only unless the task was promoted to public.

read_only_pages.name: review.detail
read_only_pages.note: Owner-only monthly review, draft or confirmed - a non-owner gets 403 unconditionally.

read_only_pages.name: reports.index
read_only_pages.note: The report list, newest first: the circle-visible daily / weekly / stock-analysis reports, plus the caller's OWN official-paper snapshots. Another member's official-paper artifacts are never listed, and the ones withheld are disclosed as a count, not silently dropped.

read_only_pages.name: stock-analysis.report
read_only_pages.note: One batch of the public stock analysis, by YYYY-MM-DD date.

read_only_pages.name: official-paper.report
read_only_pages.note: Owner-only: the paper account's post-open P&L artifact for that date, readable only by the member it is attributed to.

read_only_pages.name: daily.report
read_only_pages.note: The public daily report for a YYYY-MM-DD date. Carries no per-member holdings or P&L.

read_only_pages.name: weekly.report
read_only_pages.note: The public weekly report for a YYYY-MM-DD date.

read_only_pages.name: daily.personal
read_only_pages.note: The CALLER's own daily page (holdings, discipline check, alert review). Owner-scoped: there is no way to read anyone else's.

read_only_pages.name: weekly.personal
read_only_pages.note: The CALLER's own weekly page - same owner scoping as the daily one.

read_only_pages.name: paper.page
read_only_pages.note: The official Longbridge paper account's equity curve and allocation.

read_only_pages.name: health
read_only_pages.note: { ok: true, service: "platform-app" }. The only unauthenticated route besides the login pages.

existing_but_not_yet_http.name: alert.crud
existing_but_not_yet_http.surface: local CLI (apps/openclaw-config/scripts/market-alerts.mjs: add/remove/pause/resume/feedback/list), or ask the Feishu bot - its route table drives that same CLI
existing_but_not_yet_http.note: No bearer-gated HTTP endpoint exists - a skill cannot call this over HTTP today.

existing_but_not_yet_http.name: proposal.request
existing_but_not_yet_http.surface: local CLI for creation (proposals.mjs create), or ask the Feishu bot; GET /proposal/:id above is the only HTTP surface and it is read-only
existing_but_not_yet_http.note: No bearer-gated HTTP write endpoint exists for submitting a new proposal from a skill. Approval itself is only ever the member's own tap on their Feishu card.

existing_but_not_yet_http.name: stock.analyze
existing_but_not_yet_http.surface: local CLI (stock-analysis.mjs analyze <SYMBOL>), or ask the Feishu bot for an on-demand single-symbol analysis
existing_but_not_yet_http.note: Read-only and non-publishing: it renders one symbol's analysis for the asker and writes nothing to the public analysis library. The published batch lives behind GET /stock/:symbol above.
